soft.description: Relevance scores of 0 and 1 are mapped to 0 (irrelevant), while 2 and 3 are mapped to 1 (relevant).

hard.description: Relevance scores of 0, 1, and 2 are mapped to 0 (irrelevant), while 3 is mapped to 1 (relevant).

raw.description: Jaccard similarity between reviewer and query paper tags is mapped to a 0-3 scale with 0.25 intervals.
